title: Profiling of individual through calorie and weight data
description: The companion app can analyze calorie intake, meal patterns, and weight data to create profiles of the user's health and lifestyle patterns, potentially linking this data to other datasets.

title: Processing of identified health data
description: The system requests and processes identified personal data (calorie intake, meals, weight) which can be used to identify and profile the data subject.

title: Revealing attributes in health data
description: The data collected (calories, meals, weight) contains revealing attributes about the user's health status, dietary habits, and physical condition that can support identification.

title: Data can be used to prevent denial of claims
description: The logged data can be used to prevent the user from denying certain health-related claims or actions taken through the app.

title: Detecting through observed communications
description: The data flow from user to app can be observed by third parties or the system itself, potentially revealing user behavior patterns.

title: Sensitive health data type sensitivity
description: Calorie intake, meal data, and weight entries are sensitive health-related data types that should only be collected when strictly required for the app's functionality.

title: Unnecessary treatment and analysis of health data
description: Personal data may be further treated, analyzed, and enriched in ways that are not necessary to achieve the basic functionality of the companion app.

title: Unawareness of processing of health data
description: The data subject may not be fully aware about the collection, processing, storage, or disclosure of their personal health data beyond what is explicitly stated.

title: Lack of control over data processing preferences
description: The user may lack control to set preferences or consent in how their personal health data is processed, stored, or shared.

title: Violation of data minimization principle
description: More personal health data may be processed than is actually needed for the functional goals of the companion app.

title: Insufficient data subject controls
description: Support for different data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure) may be lacking in the companion app.

title: Health data linked through user identifiers
description: Health logs (calorie intake, weight history, exercise sessions) can be linked to specific individuals through user account identifiers or device identifiers.

title: Health data linked through quasi-identifiers
description: Combination of calorie intake, weight history, and exercise sessions can serve as quasi-identifiers that can link health data to specific individuals.

title: Processing of identified health data
description: The companion mobile app processes identified health data (calorie intake, weight history, exercise sessions) which can be linked to individuals.

title: Revealing attributes in health data
description: Health logs contain revealing attributes (weight, exercise patterns, calorie intake) that support identification of the data subject.

title: Health data attributable to user
description: Health log records can be attributed to specific users, preventing them from denying certain claims about their health data.

title: Health data detected through observed communications
description: Health data can be detected through observed communications or data flows to the health log store.

title: Sensitive health data type sensitivity
description: Health data (calorie intake, weight history, exercise sessions) is highly sensitive and should only be collected when strictly required.

title: Health data analyzed beyond functional needs
description: Health data may be further treated, analyzed, or enriched in ways not necessary to achieve the functional goals of the system.

title: Unawareness of health data processing
description: Data subjects may not be aware about the collection, processing, storage, or disclosure of their health personal data.

title: Lack of control over health data processing preferences
description: Users may lack control to set preferences or consent in how their health personal data is processed.

title: Violation of data minimization principle
description: More personal health data is processed than is actually needed for the functional goals of the companion mobile app.

title: Insufficient data subject controls
description: Support for data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure) regarding health data may be lacking.

title: Profiling of individual through health analytics
description: Health Analytics Service analyzes health data to generate inferred insights (risk indicators, summaries, trend flags) that can be used to profile individuals based on their health patterns and characteristics.

title: Group profiling through health trend analysis
description: Trend flags and routine summaries may reveal insights about groups of individuals, potentially transferring knowledge about group health patterns to other individuals through known relations of group membership or similarity.

title: Revealing health attributes disclosed
description: Health-condition risk indicators and routine summaries contain revealing attributes that support the identification of the data subject's health status and characteristics.

title: Sensitive health data type sensitivity
description: Health data is highly sensitive and should only be collected and processed when strictly required. The inferred insights may include more sensitive data types than functionally required for the basic app functionality.

title: Data propagation to companion app
description: Health analytics data is propagated to the Companion Mobile App where it may be accessible by parties where it is not strictly needed for the core health analytics functionality.

title: Data exposure to multiple parties
description: Personal data is made accessible to more parties (the Companion App) than functionally necessary for the health analytics service's core purpose.

title: Unawareness of health data processing
description: Data subjects may not be aware that their health data is being analyzed and that inferred insights are being generated and shared with the Companion Mobile App.

title: Lack of control over data processing preferences
description: Data subjects may lack control to set preferences or consent in how their health data is processed and shared with the Companion App.

title: Violation of data minimization principle
description: More personal data is processed (health analytics insights) than is actually needed for the functional goals of the Companion Mobile App.

title: Potential unlawful processing of health data
description: Processing of sensitive health data may not be processed in a lawful way, particularly if consent is not properly obtained or if automated decision-making is performed on sensitive personal data.
